company.name: Flux QR
company.shortDescription: Flux QR is a financial services company that specializes in the fields of mobile payments, fintech, and POS technology.
company.description:
Flux enables QR-Code payments at existing payment terminals with a plug-n-play device. Flux has developed a bar-code reader that scans QR-codes from any phone and transmits the payment credentials in the QR to the terminal as an electro-magnetic signal that the terminal receives as if a card was swiped.

The company was founded in 2018 and headquartered in Maine, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile payment service enabling customers to purchase on credit without credit cards, with merchants receiving payment upfront and customers repaying later.
productsAndServices.name: Flux QR Credit Payment Service
